_: Demo data for ?demo=1. The people, finds, swaps and fit checks are invented; vintage.js adds them to the demo boards (boards-fake.js), which already holds three of the finds and one of the swaps by title. The shops are the first six of data/vintage-shops.json and the designs six of all-day/data/merch-designs.json, copied as they are, so the demo never shows an hour or an address that is not real. days is how long a post has left; photo is a placeholder palette.
